fields.bio: Family-run mixed farm on the northern edge of Bristol, producing seasonal vegetables, free-range eggs and salad crops for over 30 years. All produce is grown without pesticides.

Award-winning artisan dairy producing fresh milk, clothbound cheddars and thick live-culture yoghurts from our small herd of grass-fed Friesians. All milk is unhomogenised and non-pasteurised (farm sale).
Certified organic growers in St George specialising in heritage tomato varieties, foraged seasonal produce, homemade preserves and long-ferment sourdough. Soil Association certified since 2019.
Small-batch artisan bakery in Long Ashton. We mill our own flour from locally grown wheat and bake in a wood-fired deck oven. Everything is made by hand from scratch — no additives, no shortcuts.
Urban and peri-urban beekeepers with hives across Bristol's parks and allotments. Our honeys reflect the city's wildflower diversity — each jar is raw, unfiltered and traceable to a specific apiary.

Peri-urban market garden in Kingswood growing over 40 varieties of salad leaves, brassicas, cucumbers and herbs year-round using polytunnels and no-dig beds. Supplying Bristol restaurants and households since 2023.

Traditional cider orchard and fruit farm just outside Bristol, growing over 30 varieties of apples and pears. We press our own single-variety juices and make small-batch fruit preserves and chutneys each autumn.
